hooks.name: Rerun recovery tests on decoder adapter or engine save
hooks.description: Requirement 20.2. When a Python file under taperescue/decoder_adapter/ or taperescue/engine/ is saved, run the recovery test suite: engine, decoder adapter and integration tests (decoder subprocess, fixture decode, end-to-end recovery), then the property tests in a separate pytest run. The property tests' generator-coverage checks only pass when tests/properties runs on its own or with the full suite, so they get their own invocation.

action.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/engine tests/decoder_adapter tests/integration -q && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/properties -q
